terms.comment: The adjective centrālis, central, is in Pliny; Traupman uses it as a noun for the centre in basketball, American football and hockey.

phrases.latin: Quod ego statūrā prōcērā sum, ego centrālis sum.
phrases.english: Because I am tall, I am the centre.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 43, 46, 47, 48.
